name: Dream friend
source:
A game about how sometimes your anxiety makes you percieve things differently and makes you question what is real or not. Are these the tricks of your mind or is there something more sinister at play? Only time will tell.

[From [url=https://kitziss.itch.io/dream-friend]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这款游戏讲述的是有时你的焦虑如何让你以不同的方式看待事物，并让你质疑什么是真实的或不是真实的。这些是你的心理诡计还是有更险恶的东西在起作用？只有时间才能证明一切。

[来自[url=https://kitziss.itch.io/dream-friend]Itch.io[/url]]
